test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
Eight persons J, K, L, M, N, 0, P and Q are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. N is between M and J. P is second to the left of K. O is between Q and P. L is second to right of O. N is to the immediate left of J.

Who is sitting at third place to the right of P?
solution:
From the given information:

Step 1: N is between M and J. N is to the immediate left of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36da07b3a437465efcade99f9f5aec9e4a0e709c28769b0cbdcca65b7844ef1f.png] We place N to the left of J and them place M neighboring N.

Step 2: P is second to the left of K. O is between Q and P. L is second to right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92cb75b6f968d4797ca60e5c2ab4360ead90e1d60ae7eb7c5e8a2d7fbbe8358a.png] We place K near M and then place P to second right. Now we place O and Q according to the condition.

In last we place L on the only spot left and it fulfils the given condition.

From the pattern we can see that **M**** is sitting third to the right of P.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 1.**
